title: EPILOGUE // EMERALD RUIN
narrative: Cersei drops the vial with a radiant smile. Below King's Landing, three hundred caches of Aerys's wildfire ignite in chained fury. A geyser of green flame tears through the streets, consuming dragons, armies, and palaces alike in a single cataclysmic instant. King's Landing becomes a lake of green glass beneath the cold stars.
